terminalAuthority20261023.finding: CortexDiscover REAP can invoke FINISH after the worker FSM ends. FINISH validates the original native leg and saved finite deadline but previously did not use that deadline to bound a later doMove/doFollow return command. A matching native destination could therefore grant command authority long after the investigation episode.
terminalAuthority20261023.implementation: Native cleanup command authority now ends at the saved original server deadline plus30seconds, consistent with the finite naval-egress retirement window. All previous exact destination, group operation, actor and external-owner checks remain. Metadata retirement remains available after the cutoff; no new timer, worker, deadline renewal or native command is added.
terminalAuthority20261023.limitations: No native return-command acknowledgement protocol. An already-running unchanged native leg may remain after late metadata retirement. Does not prove smooth exit, formation or reliable physical handback. Whole clearance already uses separate exterior settlement and optional unchanged-route continuation; no broad claim of resolving historical wedge screenshots.

durableSubformation20261023.gap: Individual indoor FINISH could run with the public order alone after owner/local-brain retirement, but its nine-field order omitted the original native formation leader. Cleanup defaulted to group leader; requestBefore was local and per-leg, insufficient as a durable original formation receipt.
durableSubformation20261023.implementation: Append one typed OBJECT formation leader to the existing public order at START, retain it in the local brain, and preserve it through target/issued/disjoint-operation updates. FINISH parses the ten-field journal even without local brain and requires unchanged current formation identity before existing owned-leg cleanup. It returns to the saved eligible same-group formation, with existing group leader fallback for dead/departed/ineffective anchors. Group leader authored MOVE is resumed only for an original self-led formation. SELECT rechecks the original formation immediately before movement. Explicit-clear preflight and peer-target reservations read the same ten-field order.
durableSubformation20261023.bounds: Existing generation, group, operation, native route, actor reservation, protected tasks, original deadline+30 and defensive-position retention remain. No fresh admission, replay, new callback/group/pair controller or alternate movement authority. Unknown old/malformed order shape grants no cleanup command. Leader-self return is permitted.
durableSubformation20261023.cost: One additional object reference per public order and constant formation checks. No new messages beyond existing order publication, geometry, world scan or worker. Replication and runtime cost remain unmeasured.
remaining: Current code retains the receipt across journal-only cleanup, not an ordered snapshot or owner-ready acknowledgement protocol. Missing/malformed delivery cannot be upgraded to proof.
Actual native formation identity during doMove, owner migration, follow acknowledgement, physical reunion, repeated investigation/CQB flow and performance remain unverified.
No claim that complete whole-building CLEAR or every infantry executor now preserves native subformations.
